description: This file defines the 'FreeCheckout' class that extends the OpenCart system controller, specifically handling the admin interface for the 'free_checkout' payment extension. It includes methods for rendering the configuration page and saving settings related to the free checkout payment extension.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: Controller class for managing the free checkout payment extension settings within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the free checkout payment extension in the admin interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of settings for the free checkout payment extension, responds with JSON status.
